name: v282_assets_credit_news_minus_015
hypothesis: Asset and credit event sentiment may capture balance-sheet information not fully represented by the existing reversal/buyback/quality alpha; subtracting a small exact blocker sleeve should preserve the event signal while reducing portfolio overlap.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_ess_assets, 90), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_ess_credit, 90), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(rp_nip_assets), 90), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(rp_nip_credit), 90), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_maxguidance)) - rank(vec_avg(anl4_fs_guidance_af_v4_nd_minguidance))), 126), industry) + 0.100 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1) - 0.15 * (0.40 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(common_stock_buyback_payments / cap, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry))

name: v282_netprofit_guidance_confidence
hypothesis: Positive annual net-profit guidance with a narrow guidance range can proxy management confidence while using a low-crowding net-profit surface rather than the occupied EPS/FCF route.

name: v282_netprofit_estimate_revision_confidence
hypothesis: Rising annual net-profit consensus with low analyst dispersion should identify improving earnings power without directly reusing EPS yield.

name: v282_domestic_revenue_resilience
hypothesis: A higher domestic revenue mix can reduce foreign-currency and global demand exposure; within industries this may behave as a resilience signal distinct from ordinary profitability.

name: v282_news12_event_vwap_reversal
hypothesis: When event-day closing VWAP runs far above the main-session VWAP on abnormal event volume, the move may partly mean-revert after the news is absorbed.

name: v282_news12_open_gap_reversal
hypothesis: Large news-related opening gaps can overreact, especially when measured directly from the event module rather than ordinary daily OHLC.
